testCases.name: test_case_0
testCases.input: What are the two main metrics used to evaluate a retriever?
testCases.actualOutput: The two main metrics used to evaluate a retriever are recall and precision. Recall measures how many of the relevant documents were retrieved, while precision indicates how many of the retrieved documents were actually useful.
retrievalContext: We will use two metrics for evaluation. One will be recall which tells how many of the right documents I was able to bring and the second is precision which means how many of the documents I brought were of use.

testCases.name: test_case_1
testCases.input: What does faithfulness evaluate in a generator?
testCases.actualOutput: Faithfulness evaluates whether the answer generated by a model is based on the given context or if the model hallucinated.
retrievalContext: In evaluating the generator, one metric will be faithfulness which basically tells whether the answer is generated in the given context or the model hallucinated by itself.

testCases.name: test_case_2
testCases.input: What are the three metrics in the RAG triad?
testCases.actualOutput: The three metrics in the RAG triad are context relevance, faithfulness, and answer relevance.
retrievalContext: As soon as you make the RAG pipeline, you check three metrics and we call these three metrics RAG triad. First is context relevance, which tells that for a given question the context which has been fetched from retriever is relevant or not with the question. Second is faithfulness, which basically tells us that the answer generated is generated from context or something hallucinated by the model. Third is answer relevance, which tells whether the answer generated is relevant for the question or not.
